meaning: MAINLINE PLAY-state code. STATE == 0 takes the IFEQ arm and dispatches to the PLAY handler (W3MAIN.MAC:507-525). Hex 0 under W3COMN.MAC's inherited .RADIX 16.

MAINLINE PAUSE-state code. Hex 80 sets the high bit, so as a signed byte STATE < 0 and MAINLINE's IFMI (branch-on-minus) dispatches to the PAUSE handler (W3MAIN.MAC:507-525). The hex reading is forced by that sign test; decimal 80 would still be positive and dispatch down the SETUP branch.

MAINLINE SETUP-state code. Hex 40 > 0 with the high bit clear, so STATE > 0 takes MAINLINE's ELSE arm to the SETUP handler (W3MAIN.MAC:507-525); the cold start writes it to STATE (W3MAIN.MAC:491 LDA I,S.SETU). Hex 40 under .RADIX 16.

Cold start: the cabinet boots into SETUP with ATRACT on. Power-up loads S.SETU (W3MAIN.MAC:491 LDA I,S.SETU) and stores it to STATE (:493 STA STATE), and ATRACT is the ;ATTRACT (0)/GAME (-1) FLAG (:135) — so the machine comes up in SETUP/attract, not play. This is the boot state mc6-4 wires; mc6-2 files the anchor.

The first SETUP task is NEWGAM, reached through the SETUP1 task-address list — SETUP1: .WORD NEWGAM-1 (W3MAIN.MAC:583) -> NEWGAM (:3835). NEWGAM seeds a fresh game on wave 1 (LDA I,1 / STA WAVENO), the reseed mc6-2's startGame performs. The -1 is the ROM's RTS-vector convention (address minus one, pushed for an RTS dispatch).
